title: Man slumped on the bus
caption: It is very late in the day (around 4 in the morning), and I am heading home from the club, Razzmatazz in this case, and I happened to snap a photograph of this man beside me.
alt: We are on a bus, looking across the aisle at a man whose neck makes a 90-degree angle with the seat, parallel to the floor. His hands are clasped, his bag is beside him, and he is framed by his seat and a window pane, viewing some closed garage doors.
